description: ufw and firewalld both configured — the state a host reaches by being built from an Ubuntu base and then managed by a Red Hat-shaped playbook. Each flushes the ruleset on start and installs its own, so which one filters depends on unit start order. NETWORK-0003 fails; 0001 and 0002 still pass, because both configurations are individually sound and that is precisely what makes the conflict hard to notice.
